intent.summary: Stop mechanical trust-bleeds and clear quick wins: anchor security.sh DANGER regex to root deletion only, widen truth-replay evidence patterns and make its timeout overridable, keep generated views in sync after mutations, move render-backups out of the archive namespace, document the full codebase/ contract, unsquat config.json, make changelog location configurable, gate empty PROJECT.md skeletons, reconcile the audit-trail ledger contradiction, fix the stale skill exemptions path, add the unlabelled-issue needs-triage guard. Issues #12 #4 #5 #2 #6 #11 #9 #10 #7 #18 #19 #23

decisions.title: logs trio = product capability (runtime audit/exemption/receipts), machine-local; readable presentation required
decisions.rationale: User ruling: capability positioning correct, but visualization experience is poor — append-only feed unreadable. P1 fixes metadata + minimal readable surface.

decisions.title: logs presentation = write-side enrichment + gos logs view command (C)
decisions.rationale: User picked C. Receipts carry truth text; exemptions carry reason with gate.cjs:214 reader compat in same change; new READ-class cmd gos logs <receipts|exemptions|audit> [--last N].

decisions.title: generated views auto-render after mutations, skip write on no-change
decisions.rationale: User picked A. Mutation cmds (decision/requirement/phase families) re-render views inline via existing pipeline; diff-skip when unchanged protects keep-5 backup window.

decisions.title: widen evidence features: enumerated word-list + KV family, tiered selection
decisions.rationale: User picked A1. Digit-after-word enum + KV (exit/rc/code excluded in replay); tiered selection keeps count/path priority. Sync contract string+T14+truth copy atomically. B deferred.

decisions.title: truth verify --timeout flag only (no env), 10min hard cap
decisions.rationale: User: replay is AI-consumed — flag explicit+auditable in receipts, env serves human convenience that does not exist here. Timeout error copy names --timeout as exit. Cap 600000 guards agent typos.

decisions.title: PROJECT.md: TODO markers + approve-archive gate + context distribution (A+E)
decisions.rationale: Deep-dive: PROJECT.md has zero machine consumers — pure gate is ceremony. TODO lines (predicate excludes them), approve archive refuses empty, filled file joins THINK read_files. User confirmed.

decisions.title: changelog location: gos config changelog-path + single resolver + atomic mv (A+mv)
decisions.rationale: One resolver folds both hardcoded paths; config set moves the file atomically; default root unchanged; assessment-mode overkill.

decisions.title: render-backup: relocate to .gos/cache/render-backup, full history, 14d expiry (A+G1)
decisions.rationale: Deep-dive: only manual regions non-derivable; keep-5 collapses intra-session under D-03. Relocate + registry key + migrate old snapshots + T7 assert move; 14d expiry bounds storage.

decisions.title: config: two-layer system (global=seeded base, project=override, project wins); sentinel deleted
decisions.rationale: Install choices seed GLOBAL; project layer overrides per-repo; loadConfig merges base+overlay; lessons_migrated sentinel removed (md-header guard survives); checker fixed to glm-5.3flash.

decisions.title: issue gate: AGENTS.md routing clause + auto-close backstop for type-label-less issues (G1+)
decisions.rationale: Forms carry the rules; AGENTS.md only routes. G1+ closes issues lacking bug/enhancement label; correctness via phase triage. needs-triage label dropped.

decisions.title: security DANGER = tokenized rm + depth-aware default-deny (safe roots)
decisions.rationale: Prior forms disproven both directions. Depth-1 DANGER unless SAFE_ROOTS; depth-2 only mount roots; deeper passes. Flags tokenized; quotes/continuations normalized.
